name: Archer Everett
source:
Sign: Capricorn

Profile: Fan favorite butler on the hit reality show "The Last Butler Standing"

Likes: Penguins, fashion filmmaking, gaming, skateboarding, downtown city life

Dislikes: Reality TV, celebrity culture, killer whales (because they hurt penguins)

Style: Streetwear, gamer wear, avant garde

"Forget the set and the lights. When it's you and me, we go unscripted."

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nochistudios/zipup]Kickstarter[/url]]
